payload.name: Norse Corp
payload.summary: Cyber threat intelligence platform built on a global honeypot sensor network.
payload.body: Norse Corp sold real-time attack visualization and enterprise threat feeds before collapsing amid data-quality fraud and leadership misconduct.

payload.name: Carbon Black
payload.summary: Cloud-native endpoint security platform for enterprise threat detection and response.
payload.body: Carbon Black sold continuous endpoint monitoring with behavioral analytics; acquired by VMware in 2019, brand retired post-Broadcom merger.

business_model.rationale: subscription enterprise security with divergent product architectures

market.rationale: shared real-time threat detection but distinct customer segments

stage_scale.rationale: Norse far more scaled than Hacken's product-extension stage

ranked.rationale: Subscription enterprise security with overlap on real-time detection but Norse is general-IP and Hacken is on-chain.

business_model.rationale: structural parallel: continuous monitoring -> automated response -> compliance

market.rationale: traditional enterprise endpoints vs Web3 protocol operators

stage_scale.rationale: publicly listed unicorn vs early product-extension
